full_judgment: Ruhul Islam, J —This appeal by special leave arises out of the Judgment dated 5th April, 1976 of the High Court Division in First Miscellaneous Appeal No. 96 of 1974, Facts in short relevant for disposal of the appeal are like this. Respondent nos. 1 and 2 filed an application under section 96 of the East Bengal State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1960 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act," in the Court of the Additional Subordinate Judge, Noakhali being miscellaneous Case No. 6 of 1970, stating Inter ails that the respondent. Nos. 3 and 4 by a registered kabala dated 28th August, 1969 transferred .34 acres of land of plot No. 1594; .07 acres of land of plot No. 1596 ; 3.9 acres of land of plot No. 1601; 2.98 acres of land of plot No. 1602 and .08 acres of land of plot No. 1605, all appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 294 of Monza Tamta P S. Ramganj, District Noakhali for a sum of Tk. 15,000/ in favour of the appellants who are strangers, Respondents 1 and 2 claiming to have land contiguous to plot Nos. 1602 end 1605 prayed for pre-emption in respect of 2.98 acres of lend out of plot No. 1602 and, .08 acres of land out of plot No. 1605 out of the kabala land comprising 3,R6 acres of land. The respondents deposited proportionate value of the said land calculating the same at Tk. 895/00 with usual compensation.
